question: Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem is a thanksgiving dance of which community?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khasi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem** is a traditional thanksgiving dance performed by the Khasi community of Meghalaya, India.
 
• The dance is a symbol of gratitude and is conducted to thank the divine forces for a good harvest and well-being.
 
• It is celebrated annually during the spring season, usually in the month of April, and is considered a significant cultural and religious festival of the Khasi people.
 
• Both men and women participate in the dance, wearing traditional attire. Men represent protectors, while women symbolize the custodians of culture.
 
• The event takes place in a circular arena called the "Pomblang," accompanied by drum beats and traditional Khasi music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ao:**

 
 
• The Ao tribe is one of the major Naga tribes in Nagaland, India.
 
• They are known for their rich tradition of folk songs, dances, and festivals like "Moatsu Mong," which is celebrated after the sowing season.
 
• The Ao people have a distinct language and culture, with a strong emphasis on community and village governance.
 
 
 
• **Apatani:**
 
 
• The Apatani tribe resides in the Ziro Valley of Arunachal Pradesh, India.
 
• They are known for their sustainable wet rice cultivation and unique facial tattoos, which were traditionally worn by women.
 
• Their main festival is "Dree Festival," celebrated to pray for a good harvest and protection from pests and diseases.
 
 
 
• **Adi:**
 
 
• The Adi tribe is one of the largest tribes in Arunachal Pradesh, India.
 
• They celebrate the "Solung Festival," which is an agricultural festival involving rituals to appease the gods and ensure prosperity.
 
• The Adi people are known for their warrior skills, traditional dances, and vibrant cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **General Theme:** The question pertains to the cultural diversity of India, focusing on the traditional festivals and dances performed by various indigenous communities. These practices play a vital role in preserving the cultural identity and heritage of tribal groups.
